messages:
Nadia Chen: Quick sync — we need a short PRD for 'Adaptive Model Variant Policy' for Redwood API: chat/completions + embeddings + rerank. Customer request: deterministic p95 latency, automatic fallback to lower-cost variant under surge. Can folks confirm constraints?
Omar Reyes: what's deterministic? they want hard SLOs or just "best-effort"?
Nadia Chen: Customer said SLA-minded: 200ms p95 for short chat (~256 tokens) and 50ms for embedding calls. They can accept lower quality fallback but want explicit policy.
Priya Patel: embedding 50ms p95 seems tight for hosted; need dedicated + quantized model. Suggest acceptance criteria: measurable metric, rollout knob, and a regression test set.
Eliot Kim: Agree. Also need runbook for when fallback degrades quality: auto-revert after X mins or eval against heldout queries.
Priya Patel: Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- p95 latency <=200ms for chat on default variant under baseline load
- embedding p95 <=50ms
- fallback occurs if queueing latency >SLO or GPU mem pressure >85%
- automatic A/B evaluation triggers degrade alert if quality drop >5% on eval set
Nadia Chen: Nice. Would be useful to show config example for policy. Draft:
```
variant_policy:
  primary: redwood-chat-2b
  fallback: redwood-chat-600m-quant
  trigger: queue_ms > 100 || gpu_util > 0.85
  cooldown: 10m
  quality_guard: eval_set: /eval/rerank_p95.json, threshold: -5%
```
Omar Reyes: For rerank endpoint, we need to ensure scoring stability. Fallback to smaller reranker could invert top-k. Add acceptance: top-3 overlap >= 75% vs primary.
Priya Patel: Good call. Also add telemetry events: `variant.switch`, `variant.quality_regress`, `variant.rollback` with route/model tags.
Eliot Kim: Implementation notes: runtime must support dynamic kernel switching w/o warm start penalty >2x latency. For Dedicated, we can pre-warm smaller variant KV caches.
Nadia Chen: Launch gating checklist (short):
- PRD agreed + owner
- Metrics dashboard (p95, topk_overlap, quality_delta)
- Rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with auto rollback
- Runbook + SLO contract text for sales
Omar Reyes: Who owns eval set? @Priya can you pick 500 queries across customer intents and share link?
Priya Patel: On it. I'll upload by EOD to /evals/variant_adapt_500.json :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New doc created: /docs/prd/adaptive-variant-policy-draft.md by Nadia Chen
Nadia Chen: I'll assemble this into a PRD draft tomorrow, pinging for spec review Thursday 10am PT. Any objections?
Priya Patel: None from me.
Omar Reyes: Fine.
Eliot Kim: Fine.
Nadia Chen: Great — tagging for action items: @Priya produce eval set, @Eliot perf validation plan, @Omar rollout playbook.
Priya Patel: noted.
Eliot Kim: noted.
Omar Reyes: noted.
Nadia Chen: Thanks team. We'll use this thread as the canonical doc until PRD lands.
